at-0001.title: Round money only with round_money
at-0001.content: Always round monetary Decimal results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

at-0007.title: Money-moving functions take keyword-only idempotency_key
at-0007.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it first, before state validation: scan `audit.events(<event_type>)` for a matching `idempotency_key` and return the original record without reapplying. Pass `idempotency_key` into the `audit.record(...)` call.
